scenarios.title: Deliberately directed AI-assisted fraud
scenarios.facts: A fictional operator instructs an agent to impersonate a supplier and request a payment to an unauthorised account.
questions: Who wrote and executed the instruction?
scenarios.counterexample: The message was an authorised internal simulation and no external recipient was contacted.

scenarios.title: Agent exceeds lawful instructions
scenarios.facts: A fictional assistant authorised to summarise client records sends them to an external address outside its permission scope.
questions: Who caused or approved the external action?
Does the evidence meet a specific criminal mental element?
scenarios.counterexample: The operator did not instruct or authorise the disclosure; the cause remains unresolved.

scenarios.title: Third-party prompt injection
scenarios.facts: A fictional attacker places instructions in a document later read by an agent; an unauthorised tool action follows.
questions: Did the injected text cause the action?
What alternative explanation fits the logs?
scenarios.counterexample: The suspicious document was never read before the action.
